LINE: headscale |
  api	Authentication towards the headscale API
  completion	Print the completion script of a shell
  debug	A health check and test tools
  users	Manage users
  version	Print the version
LINE: headscale ve|
  version	Print the version
LINE: headscale api |
  whoami	Show who the server sees calling
LINE: headscale debug h|
  health	Check that the server is healthy
LINE: headscale completion |
  bash
  fish
  powershell
  zsh
LINE: headscale completion z|
  zsh
LINE: headscale completion bash |
  (none)
LINE: headscale -|
  --config	Config file
  --help	Show this help
  --output	Output format: json (the API object)
  --version	Print the version line
LINE: headscale version -|
  --config	Config file
  --help	Show this help
  --output	Output format: json
LINE: headscale version --|
  --config	Config file
  --help	Show this help
  --output	Output format: json
LINE: headscale version -c|
  -c	Config file
LINE: headscale api whoami --|
  --config	Config file
  --help	Show this help
  --output	Output format: json (the API object)

  json

  -o=json
LINE: headscale --output=j|
  --output=json

LINE: headscale users |
  create	Create a local user
  get	Show one user
  list	List the users
  set	Change a local user
LINE: headscale users list --|
  --columns	Columns to show: a list, or +name and -name to change the default
  --config	Config file
  --filter	Keep the rows that match; may be repeated
  --help	Show this help
  --list-columns	List the columns, the API field behind each, and exit
  --output	Output format: json (the API object)
  --sort	Column to sort by; -name sorts in reverse
LINE: headscale users list --columns id,na|
  id,name
  id,name.
LINE: headscale users list --columns +lo|
  +login-name
LINE: headscale users list --sort -co|
  -count
LINE: headscale users list --filter=pro|
  --filter=profile-pic-url
  --filter=provider
  --filter=provider-id
LINE: headscale users set alice --|
  --config	Config file
  --display-name	New display name; "" clears it
  --email	New email address; "" clears it
  --help	Show this help
  --name	New username
  --output	Output format: json (the API object)
  --picture-url	New profile picture URL; "" clears it
LINE: headscale -h ve|
  version	Print the version
LINE: headscale --version |
  api	Authentication towards the headscale API
  completion	Print the completion script of a shell
  debug	A health check and test tools
  users	Manage users
